cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hand It Over
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let me handle the seating plan. You've put the exes together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then they can be civil from separate tables.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the pencil. I'll preserve the hours and move the chairs.
